environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed on an EKS Fargate profile (via AWS Lambda Web Adapter on EKS) with the following runtime constraints: (1) Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level with 'restricted' profile via admission controller label `pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted` which blocks privileged escalation and hostPath mounts; (2) Cilium CNI network policy applied to the pod namespace with L7 DNS-aware filtering that drops any DNS response containing A/AAAA records pointing to RFC1918 ranges, link-local (169.254.0.0/16), or loopback addresses — policy spec uses `toFQDNs` with `matchPattern: '*'` and `toPorts` with L7 rules denying resolved IPs in blocked CIDR list; (3) The container runs with `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` and drops ALL capabilities. The Cilium DNS proxy intercepts all DNS queries from the pod and validates resolved addresses BEFORE returning them to the application, meaning even if a DNS rebinding attack causes a second resolution to 169.254.169.254, the Cilium DNS proxy will return NXDOMAIN for any resolution that maps to a blocked IP range, regardless of when the resolution occurs.

config.platform: EKS Fargate with Lambda Web Adapter
